candidate_extraction.output_score: native Topaz log-likelihood score; higher is more particle-like
candidate_extraction.candidate_limitations: NMS suppresses peaks within radius 14 before threshold scanning; only finite NMS survivors are retained. -inf disables finite score cutoff but does not recover NMS-suppressed peaks.

coordinates: Topaz score-map integer pixel x/y is multiplied by 8 and rounded by Topaz CLI. To match the frozen CryoPPP 0-based original-image convention: x_original=x_topaz and y_original=(4096-1)-y_topaz. Native score is unchanged.
threshold_selection: Previously fixed validation threshold; no test selection or scan
weight_loading: topaz segment --model resnet16_u64 resolves the official packaged detector state_dict through topaz.model.factory.load_model; it does not torch.load the path as a model object

outlier_source_handling.rule: replace source pixels outside [P1-10*(P99-P1), P99+10*(P99-P1)] with bound; existing preprocessing audit records 33 high pixels clipped; original and GT unchanged

outlier_exception_not_used: 080.mrc is not a test100 member; all100 use original MRC sources
